newsitem.title: USA: Exxon Texas reformer back up, all units up.
newsitem.headline: Exxon Texas reformer back up, all units up.

text.p: Exxon Corp returned a 58,000 barrel per day (bpd) reformer unit at its Baytown Texas refinery to service on Wednesday following more than a month of scheduled maintenance, an Exxon spokesman said.
"We brought it up yesterday," said Exxon spokesman Bruce Tackett, adding all units at the big refinery, that has 396,000 bpd of crude distillation capacity, were back up and operating.
"All the other units are up and running," Tackett said. "They are all operating within a normal range," he said.
-- Oliver Ludwig, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
